brief: a reel for our budgeting app, keep it short

context.audience: first-jobbers who are broke by the 20th

concept: POV: it's the 20th and for once you're not scared to check your balance.
plan_outline: 1. CU · POV · static · bus seat, evening · your own hand holding a phone, thumb hovering, the screen a blank glow (2 s, the hook; on-screen line 'POV: it's the 20th' as a page)
2. MCU · eye · push in · same bus · a young woman looks at the phone and exhales, relieved, a small grin (3 s)
3. MS · eye · track · city street at night · she walks past a food stall and stops to buy something (3 s)
4. End card (page) · logo, 'Know before the 20th.' (2 s)
why: POV is a native social hook and puts the viewer inside the problem.
The app's UI is never rendered by the model; the screen glows and real screens would be composited later.
One emotional beat (relief) instead of feature lists; 10 seconds holds one idea.
